references.text: Moses emphasizes the importance of loving the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength, which is the foundation of the question asked to Jesus.
David expresses his love for God, reflecting the essence of the greatest commandment that Jesus refers to.
The command to love your neighbor as yourself, which Jesus cites as the second greatest commandment.
Jesus mentions the second greatest commandment in another context, highlighting its significance.
A similar event where Jesus is asked about the greatest commandment, and he gives a similar answer.
An expert in the law asks Jesus a similar question, leading to the story of the Good Samaritan.
